review_description: Process was simple, Salesperson did site visit and quote came through quickly. Whole process was very smooth and quick from start to finish. Installers were great and very tidy.

We used Solar Saving for installation of our initial PV system and now our home a battery. I found Michael to be excellent to deal with. He answered all my questions adapting and providing new quotes as required. I thought he was competitive and carried good knowledge of his products. The installation both times was problem free and we have been very happy with the installation quality.

The whole process from quoting to installing was professionally handled. Michael helped with assessing what size battery we require to suit our existing solar system and our grid consumption. He was also the only installer who bothered to visit our home and see what he would be working with so no “additional” costs levied.Michael also did everything he said he would when he said he would and was very good at explaining the system operation and the App. We highly recommend Solar Saving for and solar requirements that you have. The system value and quality is really good now that I have had a month of usage to better gauge the performance.

Michael and Jake initially upgraded and installed my existing Solar setup to include a battery, which meant swapping out the existing inverter and re-wiring the panels as well. I went through a few companies who didn't seem to think it was worth their time to help me out before being introduced to Michael and his team through a friend, and Michael was extremely helpful in helping me find a solution that would work. I've since used Solar Saving to do some general electrical work, as well as adding another stack of batteries to my system to make use of the rebate. Michael has always called me a week or so post installation to make sure the system is working as it should as well. Solar Saving are always on time, and their team is always professional, tidy and do impeccable work.

Stream line Quotation tailored to suit our Requirements.Installation was, Professional, Efficient and Neat.Sales team, Project manager and Installers all displayed high professionalism in their Fields.All Grid Applications and Connections were taken care of and End user training was thoroughly explained.Highly recommended Solar Company

We are extremely happy with the whole process from start to finish. Michael, Jake and the team were quick, tidy professional and most importantly communicated well. They were happy to answer any questions we had and explained how we could get the most out of Solar being installed. We have already seen a huge benefit in only a short 6 months.
Very happy with solar saving. The guys did a great job and answered all my questions!

We had our old solar system replaced with Solar Saving. From start to finish, Michael was knowledgeable and committed to helping us find the best system for our needs. He took the time to explain all of the options and answer any questions we had.The installation itself was seamless and the new system has worked flawlessly since the install. We are already saving on our electricity bill and we are even able to monitor our power usage throughout the day.Michael followed up with me after the installation to ensure everything was working properly and that I was satisfied with their service.If your looking for premium materials and high quality workmanship, I highly recommend Solar Saving. Their commitment to quality and customer satisfaction sets them apart from the rest.

We highly recommend Solar Saving, they provided us with detailed quotes and were available to answer any questions that we had about the products or the installation.The installation went smoothly, and the team was very diligent in keeping the site clean and keeping us notified on any delays due to weather at the time.After the system was set up and running they took plenty of time to show us how to operate and maintain the system and maintained open communication in case we required any further assistance.

Solar saving was prompt and efficient in providing the quote. He was the only one to actually get onto the roof and check information provided by the satellite information. The install again was completed on time and as indicated. Michael was only to happy to answer my questions and provide information about the progress of the installation.The grid connection was organised by solar savers, and when energex came to check the power box etc, their representative was very complimentary about how the work had been done. Very very Happy with the install of the 10.375 kw system using a Sungrow inverter with Trina Vertex panels.Highly Recommend.
Amazing communication, customer service and quick and professional installation. Very reliable.

Michael and the team at Solar saving did a fantastic job creating a custom solar system that fit my needs. Michael’s recommendations are solid and unbiased, he did a sight inspection and explained the whole process to me which made it very stress free. He installed 10kws of premium solar and even installed a hot water relay so I’m using my hot water at the right time. The workmanship was incredible and i would highly recommend Michael and the team to anyone looking to get solar installed.

Excellent open communication and were a pleasure to work with throughout the process, I will be recommending and would use again. Their expert knowledge was invaluable in proposing the right package to suit my needs and budget.

We decided to go with Michael and the team from Solar Saving for many reasons but the single most important reason for us was an unbiased approach backed up with sound industry knowledge of the solar options available and a configuration that would best suit our needs both now and in the future.This was not a decision we made lightly and when shortlisting from a wide range of installers including some of the bigger industry players. An industry insight which we found alarming was there is an element of basis information being offered by many installers – that is recommendations to incorporate certain brand products which happen to be the installers "industry partners". What I found upon doing my own research was these "industry partner" products were not the best fit for what we as a customer were trying to achieve with our brief, and ultimately our solar setup/configuration.What became clear to us was who was giving honest advice about all available products and who was trying to manipulate our decision into a sale which would favour their "business partners" rather than our (the customer) needs.Micheal and the team at Solar Saving was the exception – with his honest impartial advice and sound recommendations I believe we have ended up with the best solar system for our solar needs both now and into the future.
Michael and the team were very friendly and installed the panels very quickly!Definitely recommend anyone to go with Solar Savings.

Michael and Jake are incredibly professional and hard working individuals. They really went out of their way to do a fantastic installation and even attended to every annoying aspect I brought up. They worked tirelessly and even had calluses on their hands by the end of it! My 3 phase wiring upgrade, 20kw solar system, 3 inverter setup and 2 Tesla Powerwall installation could not have been done better by anyone other than Michael and Jake from Solar Saving. I highly recommend these quality installers and will definitely call them again for any further solar/battery installation work in the future! Thank you both once again for your incredible service.

I don't usually provide reviews; however - from the initial quoting through to the final installation of my panels and inverter, Michael from Solar Saving provided courteous and professional attention to detail and sound advice during the whole process.I'm a Fitter and Turner by trade and can tell that their workmanship of the installation has been first class.Our families first foray into solar panels has been seamless and issue free.Highly Recommended!
